pages.text: HBM Far View keeps the large explosion effects of NTM - Continuum visible and animated far beyond your render distance.$(br2)It covers the nuclear mushroom cloud and the Fleija, Solinium, Rainbow and Tom blast effects.

The server sends the effect to players up to a set distance. On your side the cloud is no longer hidden by chunk culling or by the fog at the edge of the render distance.$(br2)The sky flash and the sound still arrive with their own delay, as in NTM - Continuum.
pages.title: How it works
Distance
pages.text: The cloud is sent to you up to farTrackingRange blocks away, 1024 by default.$(br2)While a cloud is on screen, the camera view distance is extended to fit it, so a low render distance does not cut it off.
File: config/hbm_farview-common.toml$(br2)farTrackingRange: how far, in blocks, the effects are sent to the player. Default 1024. 0 turns the range extension off.
